variant_decisions.evidence: ASV EZK.39.25 renders 'bring back the captivity of Jacob'. The qere shevut and the ketiv shevit are orthographic variants of the same noun and are rendered identically as 'captivity'; the ASV gives no wording, italicized supply, or mapped textual note that distinguishes them, so both remain compatible and the qere base fallback carries the projection.
